company.name: Probo
company.shortDescription: Probo is a full service, web based digital print and fulfillment partner that delivers exclusively to resellers.
company.description: Probo is a full service, web based digital print and fulfillment partner that delivers exclusively to resellers. This means that the reseller can offer its customers a wide range of services and products through Probo. From canvases, panels and posters to textiles, stickers and labels, everything fully automated and 100% own production. Probo is innovation. By continually anticipating changes or creating changes, Probo distinguishes itself in the digital print market. This reseller only model is unique in the digital print market.
